comparison: Perfect agreement on primary efficacy findings (C29-C31, C37-C38, C42-C43, C66-C68). Both evaluations find the evidence for IOP reduction and outflow facility increase with hAMSCs to be well-supported. OpenEval emphasizes statistical significance across time points; peer reviewers describe evidence as 'compelling' and 'clearly show' viability.

Perfect agreement on cell localization findings (C34, C58-C61, C89-C90). Both accept the differential localization patterns between hAMSCs and iPSC-TMs shown in fluorescent imaging. OpenEval notes mechanistic implications; peer reviewers implicitly accept these findings as supporting the paracrine mechanism.

Agreement on main conclusion (C107) but with different emphasis. OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN due to lack of hypertensive phenotype in model, noting validation needed in disease model. Peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED, with all three reviewers endorsing therapeutic potential despite model limitations, focusing on demonstrated IOP-lowering from baseline.

Agreement on model limitation (C36, C102-C103). Both acknowledge the Tg mice did not exhibit expected hypertensive phenotype. OpenEval identifies this as critical issue affecting interpretation. Peer Reviewer 2 explicitly notes model 'should be used with caution' but still accepts findings as valid for demonstrating IOP reduction from baseline.

Agreement on cellularity findings (C48-C50, C53). Both accept increased TM cellularity and correlation with IOP. OpenEval provides detailed statistical validation using linear mixed-effects models. Peer reviewers accept without critique, noting cellularity increase as part of therapeutic mechanism.

Agreement on conventional outflow pathway mechanism (C72, C74). Both accept the strong correlation (R²=0.99) between measured and expected IOPs. OpenEval details mathematical reasoning; peer reviewers accept conclusion that effect operates through conventional pathway without questioning the analysis.

Agreement on iPSC-TM inferior performance and safety (C32, C39, C44, C83-C84). Both accept that iPSC-TMs showed significantly worse outcomes than hAMSCs. OpenEval notes high tumor rate may have affected measurements; peer reviewers explicitly acknowledge hAMSCs are 'biologically safer' than iPSC-TMs.

Divergence on paracrine mechanism certainty (C35, C94, C101). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN, noting inference is reasonable but lacks direct evidence (secretome analysis, conditioned media experiments). Peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED without disputing mechanism, describing findings as 'compelling' and accepting mechanistic interpretation based on localization data.

Agreement on tumorigenicity findings (C33, C62-C64). Both accept histopathological evidence of tumor formation in iPSC-TM group. OpenEval emphasizes pathologist confirmation and literature context (C86-C88). Peer reviewers explicitly note 'no tumorigenicity' for hAMSCs and accept safety differential.

Agreement on BMM reduction (C57, C79). Both accept electron microscopy findings showing reduced basement membrane material. OpenEval details quantification methodology with masked annotators and literature validation. Peer reviewers implicitly accept through lack of critique, treating as supporting mechanistic evidence.

Agreement on long-term hAMSC safety (C65). Both accept no tumorigenicity observed with hAMSCs. OpenEval emphasizes this as supported by histopathology and literature on MSC safety. Peer Reviewer 1 explicitly notes 'no tumorigenicity' as critical safety finding supporting therapeutic potential.

OpenEval evaluated background/literature claims (C1-C11) as SUPPORTED with appropriate citations establishing study rationale. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers did not separately assess background literature claims.

OpenEval evaluated magnetic steering rationale claims (C12-C14) as SUPPORTED by prior work citations. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers did not separately assess methodological rationale from literature.

OpenEval evaluated cell type comparison rationale (C15-C22) as SUPPORTED by appropriate citations documenting prior work with different cell types. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers did not separately assess literature justifying cell type selection.

OpenEval evaluated model selection rationale (C23-C28) as SUPPORTED by citations, while noting authors acknowledge phenotype issue. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers addressed phenotype limitation (R4) but not the original model selection rationale claims.

OpenEval evaluated contralateral effect uncertainty (C69-C71) as UNCERTAIN, noting lack of statistical significance and age confounding. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers did not separately address potential contralateral effects.

OpenEval evaluated cellularity context claims (C75-C76) as SUPPORTED by Alvarado et al. citation. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers accepted cellularity findings without separately evaluating historical context.

OpenEval evaluated measurement validation claims (C104-C105) as SUPPORTED by comparison with prior studies. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers did not separately assess methodological validation against literature.

OpenEval evaluated methodological details (C108-C126) as SUPPORTED, noting rigorous methods with appropriate controls and statistics. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers did not provide separate evaluation of detailed methodology claims.
